tests.title: loads the deterministic foundation acceptance fixture without external effects
reconnects after a control-plane restart to a durable paused checkpoint
shows runtime-loss replanning at the authorization boundary on the second fake backend
keeps indeterminate effect recovery blocked with an actionable supervisor message
shows an actionable fail-closed message for invalid durable recovery state
reconnects to a complete linked Results surface with durable provenance and ordered audit history
reloads the durable Results projection after an expired activity cursor without duplicates
renders truthful suspended, stopping, stopped, failed, cancelled, and blocked summaries
renders authoritative verification blockers and recovery progress
submits one objective and observes the bounded organization plus replayed activity
shows actionable validation without creating a partial project
shows whether queued work waits for cognitive or runner capacity
renders every defined presence state with a bounded durable source
reloads ProjectView when retention overtakes a live stream before resubscription
shows immutable approval detail and applies an approved effect exactly once
rejects or expires approval without applying the effect and exposes the blocked reason
keeps pause, stop, resume, and terminal cancel visibly distinct
shows a passing revision as VERIFIED with independent Quality lineage
shows failing evidence and explicit remediation without completion inflation
keeps a specialist claim visibly unverified until Quality evaluates it
rejects review from the authoring lineage and exposes that lineage
shows tampered integrity evidence as blocked rather than verified
shows a stale compare-and-commit decision as requiring reevaluation
